detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Stormweaver

The Stormweaver commands the tempestuous power of thunder and lightning, shocking through the undead with electrifying grace. With each crack of thunder and flash of lightning she leaves the battlefields full of steaming ash.

Playstyle:
The Stormweaver offers players a high voltage, fast-paced playstyle, centered around rapid firing lightning spells dealing devastating AoE damage. Players who choose this class will enjoy the thrill clearing zones with the storm's symphony

Recommended for:

  • Players who enjoy fast-paced spell caster gameplay focusing around lightning skills.
  • Those who like mobility, lots of projectile interactions and clear speed.
  • If you wish to control the weather, and ruin the day for your foes.

Enter the eye of the storm as Stormweaver!
